_about: M3-ENV-03 post-import rules for the Pemakar kit (game/core/import/pemakar_kit_post_import.gd, AssetImportRules). A copy of the Brine Shoals kind: every glTF slot maps to the kit's own materials folder, and the LOD chain ends at 4,000 m because the skyline pieces (massif, Ashcrown, plume) are seen from the whole town. The kit exports no -col proxies; walk collision is m2-slice's (swap-in note in the M3-ENV-03 task file).
